summary: Frontend-only landing page testing for ServiceSpeak AI completed via Playwright on the public URL. All 19 listed test cases passed: page loads cleanly, sticky header with brand & 4 nav + demo CTA, smooth-scroll behavior, hero headline/CTAs, trusted-by, 3 service cards, 4 how-it-works steps, 4 metrics + 3 testimonials (no broken images), FAQ accordion open/close, demo form validation (empty submit shows error toast) + success path (toast + form clears), footer visible, mobile menu works at 375px. Zero console errors and zero page errors observed.

critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx renders a <Waveform /> sub-component that uses a 'wave-bar' CSS class — verify the keyframes exist in index.css to avoid silent visual regressions (no runtime error observed).
CTASection demo form is intentionally mocked (per request); ensure copy 'Demo booked' isn't shown when no real backend call has happened in production. Currently acceptable for landing-only build.
Header brand 'AI · RECEPTIONIST' overline is split into 2 lines on mobile when condensed — minor; not a blocker.
All interactive elements use data-testid consistently — good test surface.
test_credentials: N/A — public landing page, no auth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page is single-page anchored on '/'. Demo form is client-side mocked (sonner toast). All data-testids are present and stable. Mobile menu requires 375px viewport. To re-trigger empty-form sonner toast, you must remove the HTML5 'required' attributes (or set form novalidate) since browsers block submit otherwise — which is what the test does. Console is clean.
